'''November 2001 Melbourne tournament (18 November)''' was a Star Wars CCG local tournament held in Melbourne, Australia on 18 November 2001. [[Rodney Lee]] won it. It is known from Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag's tournament report.<ref name="tr-d3104">[https://www.stephenskilton.com/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-17-aim-high-melb-oz-18-11-2001d3104/ aim-high-melb-oz-18-11-2001], DeckTech (Haakon ".prototype." Geburtstag, 17 November 2001). Preservation copy: [https://stevetotheizz0.github.io/decktech_archives/reports/2001-11-17-aim-high-melb-oz-18-11-2001d3104/ GitHub Pages].</ref>

* '''Date:''' 18 November 2001
* '''Site:''' Melbourne, Australia
* '''Format:''' [[Premiere - Reflections III]]
* '''Winner:''' [[Rodney Lee]]
